authorization: User authorized direct implementation repair with original hashes/exact patch/counterexamples; root assigned this case and all raw parameter domains.
purposes: NEON canonical signed low-byte negated control avoids INT32_MIN negation UB and preserves the exact SRSHL-observed count for every int32 raw, using defined int32 remainder/negation/adjustment; high24 broadcast bits are unobserved only by SRSHL.
RVV decodes signed low byte of negated raw count, selects zero beyond (-32,32), RNU arithmetic right for negative control, wrapping left otherwise. Raw256 is valid and acts as count zero.

counterexamples.summary: 5 concrete original mismatches including rawshift32, negative and large counts. Original NEON INT32_MIN negation UBSan; original QS8 RVV defined there. Both repaired sides defined and 256 low-byte controls replayed.

canonical_control_rewrite.reason: Actual QCP probes elide certain UInt32-to-SInt32/expression casts and produce false targets; explicit bounded arithmetic avoids this frontend gap without changing either ISA primitive interpretation.
canonical_control_rewrite.scope: Only the repaired RVV count and NEON SRSHL count; no other scalar/instruction operand substituted; all raw int32 values retained.
